title: Tokyo vs Taipei: Which Should You Visit?
verdict: Tokyo wins on scale, culinary depth, and bucket-list energy. Taipei wins on value, street food, warmth, and being wildly underrated. Do both if you have 10+ days.

categories.name: Food Scene
categories.summary: Tokyo wins on variety and Michelin stars. Taipei wins on street food value and night market culture.

categories.name: Public Transit
categories.summary: Tokyo has the world's best metro. Taipei's MRT is excellent but smaller scale.

categories.name: Cultural Attractions
categories.summary: Tokyo has more landmarks. Taipei surprises with the National Palace Museum and Jiufen.

categories.name: Nightlife
categories.summary: Tokyo is 24-hour with massive variety. Taipei's night markets offer a unique form of nightlife.

categories.name: Accommodation Cost
categories.summary: Taipei hostels from NT$400/night ($12). Tokyo from ¥3,000/night ($20).

categories.name: English Friendliness
categories.summary: Both cities have excellent English signage. Taipei locals are slightly more likely to speak English.

categories.name: Day Trips
categories.summary: Tokyo: Hakone, Kamakura, Nikko. Taipei: Jiufen, Taroko Gorge, Tainan.

categories.name: Safety
categories.summary: Both are among the safest cities on Earth for tourists.

faq.question: Is Tokyo or Taipei better for first-time visitors to Asia?
faq.answer: Tokyo is the iconic, bucket-list Asia trip. Taipei is smaller, cheaper, friendlier, and consistently overdelivers relative to expectations. First-timers wanting to be dazzled: Tokyo. First-timers wanting incredible value: Taipei.

faq.question: Is Taipei much cheaper than Tokyo?
faq.answer: Significantly. Mid-range daily cost: Taipei $55–95 vs Tokyo $80–120. The gap is biggest in food (night market meals $2–5) and accommodation (hostels from $12/night).

faq.question: Is it worth combining Tokyo and Taipei in one trip?
faq.answer: Absolutely. With 10+ days, fly into one city and out of the other. No experience overlap — the cities complement each other perfectly.

faq.question: How far apart are Tokyo and Taipei?
faq.answer: About 2,100 km by air. Flights take 3–3.5 hours on budget carriers like Tigerair or Peach for ¥10,000–20,000 one way.
